official_measurement_examples.name: EN-5 land-right requirement
official_measurement_examples.fact: EN-5 states network applicants need ownership, sufficient land rights such as easements, or owner/occupier permission such as a wayleave for relevant works.

official_measurement_examples.name: Government response date
official_measurement_examples.fact: The electricity network land-rights and consents government response was published in April 2026 and updated 27 April 2026.

official_measurement_examples.name: Necessary wayleave existing process
official_measurement_examples.fact: Current guidance describes necessary wayleaves under Schedule 4 of the Electricity Act 1989 where voluntary agreement cannot be reached.

official_measurement_examples.name: Reform timing caveat
official_measurement_examples.fact: The 2026 government response says some new necessary-wayleave powers require primary or secondary legislation and precise circumstances will be set later.

official_measurement_examples.name: Section 37 scope
official_measurement_examples.fact: DESNZ guidance says consent is needed for all but the most minor overhead lines, subject to statutory exemptions and NSIP rules.

official_measurement_examples.name: NSIP overhead-line threshold
official_measurement_examples.fact: Current guidance identifies the Planning Act threshold for overhead lines at 132kV or greater and more than 2km, subject to the statutory regime.

official_measurement_examples.name: 2026 Dorset screening decision
official_measurement_examples.fact: LA-PS003968 is a 21 May 2026 EIA screening decision for a specific overhead-line Section 37 proposal.

official_measurement_examples.name: Arne screening decision
official_measurement_examples.fact: FEJ684 is a 2 April 2026 EIA screening decision for a specific approximately 465m 11kV overhead-line upgrade.
